title: Asymmetric false-pass / false-block checkpoint threshold

model.q: calibrated probability-like support that the checkpoint condition is actually satisfied
model.false_pass_cost: loss from PASS when the condition is false
model.false_block_cost: loss from BLOCK when the condition is true

invariants: Gate strictness should reflect the consequence of a false authority upgrade.
Uncertainty that straddles the action threshold remains UNKNOWN.
A numerical threshold is invalid unless its support interval is meaningfully calibrated.
This layer must not manufacture probabilities from qualitative evidence labels.
boundary: The theorem is ordinary expected-loss decision theory. HF01 currently lacks calibrated biological support probabilities, so the numeric layer is a design primitive rather than an operational biomedical rule.
